zh-Hans: 试用 AI 浏览网页时的旁观、缩放、接管和交还。打开网页表单，测试键盘输入、弹窗及横竖屏切换。让生物或地图工程助手运行后关闭并重新打开工程，检查任务和文件状态。
en-US: Watch, zoom, take over and return the browser while AI is working. Try web form input, pop-ups and rotation. While a biology or map project assistant is working, close and reopen the project and check the task and files.
